body: Hey Guys, I know that alot of you are confused by what "team sick" is, so I would like to tell you. If you play walls alot, you may be noticing me and OpticSlinky saying #TEAMSICK (sometimes spamming it, hehe) and your all get confused and leftout. Ok, so bassicly if you are off school sick, and your playing walls all day, your apart of the team. We all go on the same team, and most likely win  because we are listening to monstercat on plug.dj, lol. So yea, after reading this dumb discussion, you want to join, so go ahead xD. Me an Optic can let you in when your sick, just like a daycare, lmao.
